Card Q&A.q: Can I also activate this card's link effect by trashing this card itself when it's a link card?
I used  and have a Digimon that has multiple link cards including this card. Can I use this card's Link effect to trash one of that Digimon's link cards other than this card?
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to link a card that doesn't have ?

Card Q&A.a: No, even if this effect didn't suspend the target, it can still give it "can't unsuspend."
Card Q&A.q: I chose a target to suspend using this card's [All Turns] effect. At such times, if the target can't suspend, does that mean it can't gain "can't unsuspend"?
Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to give "can't unsuspend" to an opponent's Digimon or Tamer without choosing a target to suspend?

Card Q&A.a: No, it counts toward a use of [Once Per Turn]. Even if it didn't suspend an opponent's Digimon or Tamer, the "can't unsuspend" part of the effect is mandatory, therefore it counts toward the [Once Per Turn] limit.
Card Q&A.q: If this card's [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] effect didn't suspend an opponent's Digimon or Tamer, does that mean it doesn't count toward the [Once Per Turn] limit?
